title: Personal assistant
description: Founder's personal assistant: daily help, reminders, personal tasks and private notes. Not a company worker.

model.credentials: shared Hermes provider login; no token files are copied

out: spending, public posts and outbound messages

memory.hindsight_bank: personal (planned: a separate bank, never the company bank)

isolation_note: Same container and same Hermes data volume as the company profiles: this is a logical separation, not confidentiality against another profile or a container operator.

connectors.email: blocked on founder: needs a founder-authorized Google session
connectors.calendar: blocked on founder: needs a founder-authorized Google session
connectors.private_documents: blocked on founder: needs a scoped Drive location
